output.sql:
SELECT p.method, ROUND(AVG(p.paid_at - o.order_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay
FROM marts.fct_payments AS p
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY p.method
ORDER BY p.method
output.explanation: Days to pay is measured from the order date to the payment date (paid_at), averaged over individual payments for each method. An order paid in several instalments counts once per payment, and the average is not weighted by amount. All recorded payments are included, whatever the order status. Unpaid orders have no payment record, so they don't affect the result.
